entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Hello, you've reached VeloFit. My name is Isaac. How can I help you today?
Hi Isaac... I'm calling about an order. I feel so bad about this, but I think I need to make a return.
I can certainly help you with that. To get started, could I please have your name and order number?
Of course. It's Maria Valenti, order VF-8675309.
Thank you, Maria. I see the order here for the Aero-Pro Helmet. So I can best assist you, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?
Oh, it's definitely not a fault. The helmet is beautiful. It's just... the color. It looked like a brighter red online, but in person, it's more of a maroon. It just doesn't match my gear at all.
I see. So it wasn't quite the shade you were hoping for.

Exactly. I haven't even taken it out of the plastic. The box is completely unopened, I promise. I've been a loyal VeloFit customer for years, and I was so worried I wouldn't be able to return it. I really needed this money back for holiday gifts.
I completely understand, Maria, and we definitely appreciate your loyalty. Let me just check the return eligibility for you. One moment.

Okay, I've just reviewed our policy. Your helmet is a standard item, and I see it was delivered 14 days ago. You are well within our 90-day return window, so we can absolutely process this for a full refund.
Oh, are you serious? That's such a relief! I was so stressed about it.

Of course. We want to make sure you're happy with your purchase, and your safety is what's most important. Feeling good in your gear is part of that. Because you're a VIP member, I'm emailing you a pre-paid return shipping label right now, so there will be no cost to you.
Isaac, that is just wonderful. You've really made my day. Thank you so much for being so understanding.
It's my pleasure, Maria. Once we receive the helmet, you'll see the refund processed in 3-5 business days. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's everything. Thank you again!
You are very welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a wonderful day.
